args: sc.exe config NgcSvc start= delayed-auto; sc.exe config NgcKeyIso start= delayed-auto; sc.exe config WbioSrvc start= delayed-auto; $ngcPath="$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Microsoft\Ngc"; $count=(Get-ChildItem -Path $ngcPath -Recurse -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Measure-Object).Count; Write-Host "NGC file count: $count"; if($count -gt 100){icacls $ngcPath /grant Administrators:F /T /C /Q; Remove-Item -Path "$ngcPath\*" -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host 'NGC cleared'}; net stop NgcSvc; net stop NgcKeyIso; net stop WbioSrvc; Start-Sleep 2; net start WbioSrvc; net start NgcKeyIso; net start NgcSvc; Write-Host 'Done - passkey services restarted'
msg: Fix slow passkey auth: set Hello services delayed-auto, clear bloated NGC if >100 files, restart services. Run as Admin.

content:
@echo off
cd /d C:\Users\endos
where claude >nul 2>&1 && (claude & goto :end)
where npx >nul 2>&1 && (npx @anthropic-ai/claude-code@latest & goto :end)
node "%APPDATA%\npm\node_modules\@anthropic-ai\claude-code\cli.js" 2>nul && goto :end
echo Claude CLI not found. Run: npm install -g @anthropic-ai/claude-code
pause
:end

msg: Global install @anthropic-ai/claude-code so claude command works directly
